rtc_anomaly.event: Time-Service ID 52: time set with offset 448320 seconds
rtc_anomaly.interpretation: The hardware RTC was 5.19 days behind at this boot and was corrected by NTP. A real-time clock that does not advance across power-off is the signature of a depleted CMOS/RTC battery, which is itself consistent with repeated abrupt loss of wall power.

checkpoint_state.resume_rationale: A checkpoint whose BatchNorm running statistics contain inf/nan produces NaN in every subsequent eval-mode forward pass. Resuming propagates the poisoning indefinitely; it does not recover.

mechanism.model_construction: src/models/segformer_b0.py builds SegformerForSemanticSegmentation from SegformerConfig ONLY; no pretrained weights are loaded (documented as intentional in the module docstring: 'NO pretrained weights, NO from_pretrained download').
mechanism.divergence_factor: 10x higher LR than the frozen authority, with a first-order optimizer instead of AdamW
failure_chain: 1. SegFormer-B0 is trained from random initialisation, so early activations are large and unnormalised.
2. LR 1e-3 on a transformer with no gradient clipping grows the decode-head activations until they overflow the fp16 autocast range.
3. The decode head's BatchNorm1d(256) receives an infinite batch mean from the overflowed activations; running_mean becomes inf, and running_var becomes nan (inf - inf).
4. From that point every eval-mode forward pass is NaN, and the training loss itself goes NaN at epoch 5.
5. AMP GradScaler cannot protect against this: the overflow happens in the forward pass and the BN running-statistics update, neither of which is guarded by the scaler.

protocol_authority_gap.finding: No SegFormer configuration exists anywhere under configs/ (grep for 'segformer' in configs/ returns zero files). The frozen internal baseline authority (configs/phase09_clean_v3, phase10_clean_v3) covers only the UNet family.
protocol_authority_gap.consequence: SegFormer-B0's hyperparameters have NO frozen authority. The runner's Adam(lr=1e-3) is the only definition it has ever had, and it was never validated before being committed to a 3-seed matrix.

remaining_work_if_unfixed.outcome: 3/3 runs diverge to NaN within ~5 epochs; ~0.75 h each, all scientifically void

part_3_matrix_state.note: segformer_b0_seed42 has 5 void epochs and a poisoned checkpoint; registry still reads RUNNING for it and requires correction to a technical-failure state before any relaunch.

part_4_recommendation.rationale: Relaunching segformer_b0 under the unchanged configuration would reproduce the identical divergence in ~45 minutes per run and consume ~34 GPU-hours producing NaN. Changing the learning rate is a scientific configuration change and requires explicit operator approval under the standing EXT-03 rules.

options.label: Frozen-protocol LR for SegFormer only
options.change: AdamW, lr 1e-4, bce_dice, augmentation, for segformer_b0 x3 only
options.consequence: Matrix completes; SegFormer is protocol-faithful while the 4 CNN families are not, so the table needs an explicit per-family protocol note.

options.label: Full protocol fidelity, all 15 runs
options.change: AdamW + 1e-4 + bce_dice + augmentation for every architecture
options.consequence: Defensible single-protocol table; invalidates all 12 completed runs.

options.label: Hybrid: keep 12 as reduced-protocol, add seed-42 frozen-protocol column
options.change: Frozen protocol for 5 architectures x seed 42 only, plus segformer x3 at 1e-4
options.consequence: Paper gets one protocol-faithful comparison row plus a 12-run seed-variance study; cheapest path to a defensible table.

options.consequence: Matrix closes at 12 runs / 4 architectures; SegFormer exclusion must be disclosed with the D99 divergence as justification.
